claims.text: Narrow-band UVB is often the preferred first treatment for widespread vitiligo, especially when immunosuppression is contraindicated; excimer laser for localized disease not responding to topicals. Discuss the theoretical skin cancer risk;
claims.quote: Narrowband UVB (NB-UVB) is often the preferred initial treatment for widespread vitiligo, especially in patients for whom immunosuppression is contraindicated (3). Excimer (308 nm) laser may be useful, particularly for patients with localized disease that does not respond to initial topical therapy. When considering phototherapy, the theoretical increased risk of skin cancers should be discussed with patients.
Patients undergoing phototherapy may benefit from regular skin cancer screenings.
